ARCHITECTURAL CINEMA / 52 SECONDS

AL MAR.
A 12-villa coastal development.

My role: creative direction, interior concept design & visual production

I created this architectural film for AL MAR, a coastal development of 12 villas. I modeled the scenes in 3ds Max and rendered them with V-Ray, then used GPT, Nano Banana, and Seedream for image enhancement and additional imagery. I animated the visuals with Kling and Seedance, created project-specific music with Suno, and completed the compositing, video editing, and music integration in Adobe After Effects and CapCut.
